The '''Mechthorian''' was a model of [[Security droid/Legends|security droid]] manufactured by the [[Stonewall Labs]] company during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Era]]. The droid resembled the [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] [[Species/Legends|species]] and was taller than a medium-sized [[Human/Legends|Human]]. The Mechthorian was able to fight using ranged weapons.<ref name="SWG:ORDMTD" />

==History==
Mechthorians were manufactured by Stonewall Labs during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Era]]. When the Stonewall Labs facility on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] was closed, security droids remained activated. Several [[ZH-28 guard]]s, [[SWL-5 overseer]]s, [[LC-92 antagonist]]s, Mechthorians and [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]]s continued their patrol programs in the laboratory and in the surrounding area.<ref name="SWG:ORDMTD" />
In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] was trying to acquire an experimental [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]] droid module from a [[Droideka/Legends|droideka]] in the Stonewall Labs facility. The spacer entered the laboratory and fought several Mechthorians to finally access the module.<ref name="SWG:ORDMTD" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Mechthorians appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:ORDMTD" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Mechthorians were added to the game as part of the "[[W:c:swg:Legacy Quest|Legacy Quest]]" with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]," a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref>
